_what_this_is: Verbatim record of an external data-acquisition report produced by a browsing assistant on 2026-08-21, relayed by the operator. This session has no egress and could NOT verify any statement here against its cited source.

verification.reason: This environment has no network egress; every claim below is second-hand.
verification.consequence: These findings are recorded as EXTERNALLY_REPORTED evidence. They do NOT by themselves establish a Phase 4 research verdict, because a verdict requires evidence this run can reproduce.

CORE.index_asked_about: MSCI ACWI Net Total Return EUR
CORE.finding: No official MSCI ACWI Net-Total-Return EUR monthly dataset with >=360 months could be verified as usable and redistributable in a public repository without specific MSCI permission. The EUR net-return factsheet confirms the index and the net-return convention but is not a downloadable raw series. MSCI expressly forbids reproduction and redistribution of its index data without prior written consent.
CORE.redistribution_in_public_repo: not permitted without prior written MSCI consent
CORE.CRITICAL_CAVEAT: The question was asked about the WRONG INDEX. See instrument_benchmark_mismatch below.

GOLD.finding: LBMA has moved historical tabular precious-metal prices into the MyLBMA portal; access requires an ICE Benchmark Administration licence. Without one, LBMA directs users to purchase from ICE.
GOLD.redistribution_in_public_repo: not permitted without the relevant IBA licence

HICP_EA.finding: The series key this repository specified, ICP.M.U2.N.000000.4.ANR, was DISCONTINUED on 2026-02-04 and replaced by HICP.M.U2.N.000000.4D0.ANR following a methodological change. Coverage reported as 1996-12 to 2026-05, monthly, euro area changing composition, annual rate of change, source Eurostat.
HICP_EA.licence: OPEN, reuse permitted with source attribution (Eurostat reuse policy)
HICP_EA.not_delivered: No rows, no row count, no SHA-256 - the reporter declined to transcribe rather than risk fabrication.

SHORT_RATE_EA.finding: Bundesbank publishes the official monthly euro short-term rate series BBMMB.M.EU000A2X2A25.WT ('Euro Short-Term Rate, monthly average') with CSV download. Native coverage begins 2019-10.
SHORT_RATE_EA.licence: OPEN, reuse permitted with attribution, statistics and metadata not to be altered

splice_rule_if_extended.rule: EONIA was computed under the old methodology until 2019-09-30. From 2019-10-02 until its discontinuation on 2022-01-03 EONIA was mechanically €STR + 8.5 basis points. €STR was first published 2019-10-02 and refers to the previous TARGET2 business day.
splice_rule_if_extended.requirement: Any EONIA extension is a SPLICE and requires its own documented splice rule and data_status. It must never be applied silently.

BUND_LONG_YIELD.finding: The legacy key BBK01.WT3230 specified by this repository could not be mapped reliably onto the current Bundesbank database structure. A present-day candidate exists but equivalence is NOT established.
BUND_LONG_YIELD.candidate_description: Umlaufsrenditen inländischer Inhaberschuldverschreibungen / börsennotierte Bundeswertpapiere, monthly
BUND_LONG_YIELD.blocking_condition: May only be mapped to BUND_LONG_YIELD once the yield concept originally meant by WT3230 is established. Equivalence is unproven.

core_proxy_question_B.candidate: Kenneth French Data Library, Developed Markets
why_rejected: Developed markets only - excludes emerging markets, so not ACWI
No documented MSCI-style net-of-withholding-tax return concept
The international index portfolios themselves use MSCI raw data to 2006 and Bloomberg thereafter, so the licence problem is inherited rather than avoided
core_proxy_question_B.conclusion: No silent CORE proxy and no automatic PARTIAL path.

instrument_benchmark_mismatch.finding: IE00BK5BQT80 is the Vanguard FTSE All-World UCITS ETF (Acc), which tracks the FTSE All-World Index. This repository's data_registry specified the CORE calibration series as MSCI ACWI Net EUR. FTSE All-World and MSCI ACWI are different indices with different constituent methodologies.
instrument_benchmark_mismatch.consequence: Question A was answered for MSCI ACWI, which is not the benchmark of the instrument this study actually simulates. The CORE availability question must be re-asked for FTSE All-World Net Total Return EUR before any FAIL verdict can rest on it.
